nodes.label: Multi-Stage Validation Pipeline (V1-V10)
nodes.rationale: Time and LLM cost are explicitly not constraints — maximise quality; ~98 LLM calls vs 4-8 before (2-3x tokens, 15x call count, but calls are small and run in parallel).

nodes.label: V1 Full Structural Validation
nodes.rationale: Previously only the first 3 questions were checked for text/options; V1 checks ALL questions with type-aware rules plus answer-key distribution bias, and is the only blocking gate — failures feed back into a retry prompt as prior_error.

nodes.label: V2 Per-Question Content Quality Critic
nodes.rationale: qwen3-32b scores each question on clarity, NCERT faithfulness, difficulty match, answer correctness and distractor quality; if <=30% of questions fail, regenerate individually; >30% triggers full section regeneration.

nodes.label: V3 NCERT Grounding Check
nodes.rationale: Re-queries the vector store using the question text and asks whether the question is answerable from NCERT; guarded against false positives — if retrieval returned 0 chars for that chapter, V3 is skipped for its questions and the skip is logged.

nodes.label: V4 MCQ Blind Answer Verification
nodes.rationale: A fresh LLM answers each MCQ with NO context; the original design flags mismatches rather than auto-correcting because the blind LLM could be wrong on a tricky question (later upgraded in launch fixes to two-pass auto-correction); also checks answer-letter distribution.

nodes.label: V5 Inter-Question Uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Two layers: cheap token-overlap check (_concept_overlap > 0.45 flags likely duplicates) then an LLM semantic confirmation only for flagged pairs; the duplicate with the lower V2 quality score is regenerated.

nodes.label: V6 CBQ Passage Validation
nodes.rationale: Every sub-question must be answerable SOLELY from the passage (not general knowledge), with length and age-appropriateness checks; max 2 regen attempts before accepting with a logged warning.

nodes.label: V7 Bloom's/Competency Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Upgrades competency distribution from report-only to enforcement via targeted swaps of the cheapest-to-replace questions; accepts the paper with a logged violation after 2 fix rounds rather than blocking indefinitely.

nodes.label: V8 Cross-Section Coherence Audit
nodes.rationale: Paper-level LLM audit of chapter coverage, cross-section concept repeats and subject focus; only triggers targeted regeneration when critical issues exist AND coherence score < 6, otherwise accepts with a logged report.

nodes.label: V9 Image Pipeline Validation
nodes.rationale: Generates 3 Pollinations candidates with prompt variations, has Kimi vision rank them, then runs a dedicated scientific-accuracy check (score < 7 rejects the image, falling back to the next candidate or Wikimedia); also verifies sub-question answerability from the image.

nodes.label: V10 Final Paper-Level LLM Audit
nodes.rationale: The most capable model (deepseek.v3.2) performs one holistic CBSE-compliance audit per paper; reject_all should be rare — one full regeneration attempt then accept the best result.

nodes.label: Cross-Section Context Deduplication
nodes.rationale: All sections queried the same vector store and received overlapping chunks, producing similar questions across sections; a shared used_doc_ids set excludes already-used chunks, with a simpler content-string 'seen' set alternative when chunk_id metadata is absent.

nodes.label: Per-Question-Type Context Routing (TYPE_CONTEXT_PROFILES)
nodes.rationale: One context blob per section served all question types, but MCQ needs dense facts, LA needs explanatory passages and CBQ needs narrative passages; context is sized and routed per type via a context_by_type dict on the work order.

nodes.label: Context Quality Pre-Check (_validate_context_quality)
nodes.rationale: Context was retrieved and used blindly — thin context produced hallucinated questions; a cheap LLM check asks if the context suffices for N questions and retries with a broader chapter-less query on NO; <500 chars fails immediately without spending an LLM call.

nodes.label: Individual LA/CBQ Generation (generate_single_question)
nodes.rationale: One LLM call per complex question is more expensive (~5 extra calls per paper) but dramatically improves quality for LA/CBQ by giving each question dedicated context attention; a used_chapters set forces chapter diversity.

nodes.label: Adaptive Generation Parameters (TYPE_PARAMS)
nodes.rationale: Temperature and token budget vary per question type — low temperature for factual MCQ/map work, higher for LA creativity; upgrades estimate_token_budget to also return temperature.
